generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a sprawling herb of soft, weak stems with parsley-like leaves and small umbels of white flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.6 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: bright green leaves; white umbels.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.inflorescence_branches.note: Jepson eFlora's account of the species, as quoted in search results (the page itself was not read): rays 10 to 20, 1.5 to 3 cm, pedicels 2 to 6 mm; the Burke Herbarium's account gives the same rays.

appearance.organs.flower.note: Its compound umbel drawn flower by flower (spec rework L1c): its kind from the carrot family's inflorescence and its rays from its own, by the rules at the flowering plants; about 12 small white flowers about 2 mm across in each umbellet, by eye (no flora gives a count; the Flora of New Zealand gives the flower's size), the umbel 5 to 7 cm across. From floras and extension pages as quoted in search results; the pages themselves were not read. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): five white petals between five sepals on the inferior ovary, five stamens and a pistil of two carpels, from the characters of Apiaceae by the rules at the flowering plants.

traits.division_order.note: General knowledge of the species, the guides the search returned agreeing: leaves two or three times pinnate, the leaflets ovate, toothed and cleft, 1 to 6 cm long, the veins running to the teeth. The counts of pinnae and of leaflets on each are by eye from photographs.
